personas.description: You set up Health Cloud for providers, payers or life sciences firms and want to prove you know the product.

personas.label: Salesforce admins in healthcare

examDifficulty.heading: Is the Health Cloud Accredited Professional Exam Hard?
examDifficulty.summary: It is a moderate exam. You need to know Health Cloud's patient and clinical data model, how care is coordinated, and how health data comes in from other systems. Some healthcare background helps.
bullets: About 65% to pass, roughly 39 correct answers. Check the official guide for the current figure.
Data model focus. Patients, care teams, care plans and the clinical objects based on FHIR.
Industry processes. Care management, appointments, utilisation management and data integration.
examDifficulty.passRateGuidance: Set up a patient with a care plan and care team in a trial org before the exam. Before you book. Aim for 75% or more on practice tests.

examFormat.heading: Health Cloud Accredited Professional Exam Format Explained
examFormat.intro: Accredited Professional exams are taken online. Here is what to expect:
examFormat.scenarioPercent: Most questions describe a care scenario, such as coordinating a patient's care after hospital discharge, and ask which Health Cloud feature fits.
bestWayToPass: Learn the patient model: Patients as person accounts, their care team, and related clinical records.
Understand care plans: Templates, problems, goals and tasks, and how care coordinators use them.
Know the clinical objects: Conditions, medications, observations and encounters, modelled on FHIR.
Think about privacy: Health data needs tight access control and audit trails.

certificationCard.description: This exam tests how you set up Health Cloud: the patient and clinical data model, care plans and care teams, appointments, utilisation management and connections to clinical systems.

keyConcepts.h2: Health Cloud: Key Concepts for the Exam

blocks.heading: Health Cloud Data Model: Patients, Providers, and Care Plans
blocks.body: Patients and members are usually **person accounts**. The **care team** is the group of people involved in a patient's care, such as doctors, nurses, family members and care coordinators, each with a role. Health Cloud includes **clinical data objects** modelled on the **FHIR** standard, such as health conditions, medications, care observations (like blood pressure readings) and encounters (visits). Providers and their facilities, specialties and networks can also be stored. The **patient timeline** shows events like visits and results in date order.

blocks.heading: Care Plan Management and Coordination
blocks.body: A **care plan** sets out how a patient's needs will be managed. It is usually built from a **care plan template** and includes **problems** (what needs addressing), **goals** (what the patient wants to achieve) and **tasks** or interventions (the work to get there). Care coordinators use care plans to track progress, assign tasks to the care team and adjust the plan as things change. Assessments can capture information from the patient, which can feed into the plan.

blocks.heading: Intelligent Appointment Management (IAM)
blocks.body: **Intelligent appointment management** lets staff and patients book appointments with the right provider, at the right place, at a time that works. It can check the provider's availability, skills and location. Patients can book through a self-service site. Reminders and confirmations reduce missed appointments, and booked appointments link back to the patient's record and timeline.

blocks.heading: FHIR Integration and EHR Connectivity
blocks.body: Most clinical data lives in **electronic health record (EHR)** systems. Health Cloud uses objects aligned to **FHIR**, the common standard for health data, which makes it easier to bring in conditions, medications and visits. Integrations often use **MuleSoft** and its healthcare accelerators, or FHIR-based APIs, to move data between the EHR and Health Cloud. Keep the EHR as the source of truth for clinical records and bring in what care teams need to coordinate care.

blocks.heading: Analytics and Population Health Management
blocks.body: Beyond single patients, organisations want to look after groups, such as all patients with diabetes. Reports, dashboards and **CRM Analytics** can find patients who are due for check-ups or at higher risk. **Utilization management** handles requests for approval of care, such as prior authorisation, with care requests reviewed against criteria. Because this is sensitive health data, use strict sharing, field-level security, **Shield** encryption and event monitoring, and follow rules like HIPAA.

scenarioTips.h2: How to Pass the Salesforce Health Cloud Accredited Professional Exam
scenarioTips.intro: Most questions begin with a patient or care team need. Find the record that represents it, then the feature that acts on it.

blocks.heading: Health Cloud Data Model
blocks.body: Patients are person accounts. Clinical records like conditions and medications use FHIR-aligned objects.

blocks.heading: Patient 360 View
blocks.body: The patient card, timeline and care team give coordinators a full view of the patient in one place.

blocks.heading: Care Plan Configuration
blocks.body: Care plan templates define standard problems, goals and tasks. Coordinators adjust them for each patient.

blocks.heading: Interoperability: FHIR & HL7
blocks.body: Bring clinical data from EHRs using FHIR-based integrations, often with MuleSoft.

blocks.heading: Utilization Management & Prior Auth
blocks.body: Care requests capture requests for approval, which reviewers check against clinical criteria.

nextCertsAfter.heading: Next Certifications After This AP
nextCertsAfter.intro: Good next steps after Health Cloud:

sampleQuestions.question: A care coordinator needs to see everyone involved in a patient's care, including their GP, a specialist and their daughter. What feature shows this?
options: The household record for the patient
sampleQuestions.explanation: The care team lists the people involved in a patient's care, each with their role.
whyWrong: Opportunity teams are for sales deals.
Households group people who share finances, not care roles.

sampleQuestions.question: A patient leaves hospital and needs a structured plan with goals and tasks for recovery. What should the coordinator create?
options: A care plan from a template
A standard Case record and nothing else
sampleQuestions.explanation: Care plans set out problems, goals and tasks, and templates make them quick and consistent to create.
whyWrong: A Case tracks an issue, but doesn't structure goals and tasks.

sampleQuestions.question: Health Cloud's clinical objects, such as conditions and medications, are based on which standard?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Health Cloud's clinical data model is aligned with FHIR, the common standard for exchanging health data.
whyWrong: OAuth is for authorising app access.
SOAP is a web service protocol, not a health data standard.

sampleQuestions.question: Blood pressure readings from a patient's visits should be stored in Health Cloud. Which object fits?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Care observations record measurements like blood pressure or blood sugar.
whyWrong: Care team roles describe people's roles.

sampleQuestions.question: The EHR holds the official clinical records. How should Health Cloud get the data care teams need?
options: Replace the EHR with Health Cloud
Ask nurses to retype the data
Integrate with the EHR over FHIR APIs
sampleQuestions.explanation: Integration brings clinical data in automatically, while the EHR stays the source of truth.
whyWrong: Health Cloud isn't designed to replace the EHR.
Retyping is slow and causes errors.
PDFs can't be used as structured data.

sampleQuestions.question: Patients should be able to book appointments with the right provider through a self-service site. What should be used?
options: A web-to-lead form on the public site
sampleQuestions.explanation: Intelligent appointment management matches patients with providers by availability, skills and location, including self-service booking.

sampleQuestions.question: A coordinator wants to see a patient's visits, results and events in date order. What should they use?
options: A custom report built in the report builder
sampleQuestions.explanation: The timeline shows a patient's events in order on their record.
whyWrong: Building a report each time is slow.

sampleQuestions.question: A doctor's request for approval of an MRI scan must be reviewed against criteria before it is covered. Which feature fits?
options: An action plan on its own, with nothing else
sampleQuestions.explanation: Utilization management handles prior authorisation through care requests that reviewers assess.
whyWrong: Action plans list tasks but don't run the approval review.

sampleQuestions.question: A clinic wants to find all diabetic patients who haven't had a check-up in 12 months. What is the best approach?
options: Look through each of the patient records by hand
sampleQuestions.explanation: Reports and analytics on clinical data can find groups of patients who need follow-up.

sampleQuestions.question: Which measure best protects sensitive health data in Health Cloud?
options: Strict sharing, encryption and audit trails
One single shared login used by all of the staff
sampleQuestions.explanation: Health data needs tight access control, encryption and records of who accessed what.
whyWrong: Chatter isn't a secure store for clinical data.

sampleQuestions.question: A care plan template for heart failure has standard goals and tasks. A specific patient needs an extra task. What should the coordinator do?
options: Change the care plan template for every single patient
Add the task to that patient's care plan
sampleQuestions.explanation: Care plans start from templates but can be adjusted for each patient.
whyWrong: Changing the template affects every future plan.

sampleQuestions.question: A patient's medication list should be visible to the care team in Health Cloud. Which type of object holds it?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Health Cloud has clinical objects for medications, aligned to FHIR.
whyWrong: Price book entries hold product prices.

sampleQuestions.question: How are individual patients usually stored in Health Cloud?
options: As standard Product records in the catalogue
sampleQuestions.explanation: Person accounts combine account and contact details for an individual, which fits patients.
whyWrong: Products are things that are sold.

sampleQuestions.question: An assessment asks a patient about their mobility and mood. How can the answers help their care?
options: The answers inform the care plan goals
They are only ever used for marketing purposes
sampleQuestions.explanation: Assessment answers help coordinators spot needs and shape the care plan.
whyWrong: They are for care, not marketing.

sampleQuestions.question: A health network wants to record which providers belong to which networks and specialties. What should be used?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Health Cloud can store providers, facilities, specialties and networks for referrals and scheduling.
